source.plan: Callboard plan row 2026-11-13 (series in-60, walkthrough, look mono), ideas i20 and i12.
source.why: Self tape example, start to finish, in the real Ghost Light build (main b72a221, build 58): the Callboard bell lit on the home, the top line says the self tape is due today, tap it and the Tape room opens on the piece, action rolls, the prompter lights her words, cut stops it, the take flies into Tapes.
source.app: Ghost Light web preview (ghostlight-web/serve.sh), dark theme, flow flows/tape-self-tape-example.json. The demo account has no auditions, so MOCK_AUDITIONS=flows/tape-self-tape-example.auditions.json answers /api/auditions in the browser with one self tape (Midsummer, Helena, due today 6 pm, piece 540); nothing is written to the database. Camera opened at recording 6.914s.
source.footage: Pexels 36931662 ('Expressive woman speaking indoors', Pexels User) as FAKE_CAM, 720x1280/30, first frame held 3s, last held 2.2s. Real stock person, never a user, never quoted. The clip has no sound.
source.voice: ElevenLabs eleven_v3, Sarah (EXAVITQu4vr4xnSDxMaL), one take: action 0.48, line 1.60-7.45, 'And... cut.' 8.74-10.26; placed at recording 8.612 (camera 1.698). AI voice: labelled on every platform and in the captions.
source.why_not_omni: Gemini Omni returned 402 (prepaid credits depleted) on 2026-11-10, so no generated actor this time.
